method: Plain unauthenticated reads of public docs. Values in the fixtures are our own; only the shapes follow the docs.

decisions_choice_request.json.basis: DecisionsRequest and DecisionsChoiceQuestion schemas. A null criterion means a bare name (TypeSafe: a choice without a description is read by its name alone).

decisions_choice_response.json.basis: DecisionsResponse and DecisionsChoiceAnswer schemas plus the documented 200 example. The build string is DESIGN.md's, not from the docs.

error_402_in_flight.json.basis: In-flight spending budget section: this 402 is documented as transient.

chat_logprobs_request.json.basis: ChatRequest schema; provider.only, allow_fallbacks and require_parameters; reasoning.effort none is documented as disabling reasoning. logprobs has no standalone guide page (https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/features/logprobs.md is a 404).

chat_logprobs_response.json.basis: Built from the ChatResult, ChatChoice, ChatTokenLogprobs and ChatUsage schemas. The docs show no example of logprobs under a json_schema response. A top-level provider field is not in the ChatResult schema.

key_response.json.basis: GET /api/v1/key: data.usage is credits used, all time.
